title: Opening and birth in Social Circle, Georgia
summary: JCH corrects the record: he was born in Social Circle, 60 miles east of Atlanta, on May 11, 1906, to Tempie and Charles.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape

SMITHSONIAN INSTITUTION
Performing Arts
L'Enfant Plaza
Amtrak Building

J. C. Higginbotham
Side 1, Reels 1 & 2
J. C., why do they always have you born in Atlanta? Were you actually born in Atlanta?
No, I wasn't born in Atlanta.
I know. Everywhere they have you born in Atlanta, Georgia.
I know that. I was born 60 miles east of Atlanta, Social Circle.
Social Circle, yeah. Down on the farm. ...
Just for the information, what was your mother's first name, your mother and father's name?
My mother's name TEMPIE, my father's name Charles.
